text:
emily: FYI everyone  nearly missed morning check-in because my passport had an old transit stamp and the airline clerk flagged it. heart attack moment.
raj: Ugh, thats the worst. Did they let you through after explaining?
toni: Always scan passports/visas into cloud before trips. saved my butt once when we had to show a copy to customs.
emily: Yes, airline called security, I showed digital copy + hotel booking and they stamped me through. took 40min. lesson learned: double-check stamps and visa validity days before flight.
devon: Also tag your passport in phone photos: name, passport # (front page), and visa pages. encrypted note on phone works too.
sherrie: On the hotel side  pro tip: if your room key doesn't work, try the elevator card reader first. It sometimes re-authorizes after front desk swipe.
frontdesk-bot: Reminder: For offsite attendees, bring a government ID and printed booking confirmation. Front desk may require matching name and company for early check-in.
carrie: Quick poll: do you 1) photocopy passport + stash in bag 2) keep only digital scans 3) both? react 1/2/3
raj: 3 from me. redundancy ftw.
toni: 1 for me if Im paranoid, otherwise 3.
emily: I'll add a tiny "passport & visa preflight" checklist to the travel doc with a reminder to check entry stamps and visa days. thanks for the tips!
